notes: Use-case page built as five stacked gradient-background sections plus a hero and an accordion FAQ with listitem/region markup instead of the usual presentation container.

proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width [bg:gradient] zone directly before the global footer with no captured text or child nodes.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted extraction; likely a final CTA banner whose copy/button fell below the minWidth capture rather than a genuinely empty section.
proposed_rules.rationale: Same failure mode as underrendered-list-zone, applied to a CTA band instead of a list grid.

proposed_rules.trigger: A vertical stack of question rows marked with [listitem]/[region] ARIA roles (instead of the [presentation] container used elsewhere), with the first item pre-expanded showing its full answer text.
proposed_rules.decision: Extend faq-accordion-block's trigger to also match this role-based variant; capture the visible expanded answer directly as the row's second cell instead of deferring it to Phase 2.
proposed_rules.rationale: Same content/structure as the confirmed faq-accordion-block pattern, just different underlying markup semantics. Rejected alternative: treating this as a new block type, which would duplicate an already-confirmed mapping for no structural reason.
